# Collapse Label-Left Bottom Spacing Reset
In Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3, the `label-position="left"` collapse area (enterprise network access / change filing) missed the bottom padding reset rule in `detail-form.scss`.
## Root Cause
- `label-position="left"` collapse area (enterprise network access / change filing) did not match the bottom whitespace reset rule in `detail-form.scss`
## Solution
- Added `.collapse-container > .collapse-content:not(.hide)` with `padding-bottom:0` and `margin-bottom:0` in `detail-form.scss`
- Split `el-form--label-top` block and added `.detail-from-container` global override

# Presale Plan PDF URL Resolution
In Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3, the presale plan PDF must read `planDocSite` to prevent fallback navigation to the plan page.
## Root Cause
- API PDF path is at `data.plan.planDocSite`; old code wrongly read `planUrl` causing fallback to plan page
## Solution
- Added `resolvePlanDocUrl()` in `permitConstants.js` to read `planDocSite`/`planUrl` sequentially
- Called by `handleQueryPlan()` and `canQueryPlan`
- Local 404 requires `/zhi2-dev` proxy config in `vite.config.js`

# Contract Dynamic Component Prop Mapping
In Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3, after removing global registration, dynamic components rely on prop-passed mapping to eliminate unknown component warnings.
## Root Cause
- `contractContent.vue` originally depended on global `Vue.component` and `require.context` for dynamic components
## Solution
- `contractContent.vue` added `chapterComponents` prop to receive component mapping
- `contract/index.vue` and `stock/contract/detail.vue` use `import.meta.glob` to build mapping and remove `Vue.component` and `require.context`
- Pass via prop to eliminate unknown component warning
